Sam H: Heads up — planning to run the users_profiles schema change tonight 02:00 UTC (index + small column backfill). Need deploy owner, backfill owner, and smoke/rollback readiness. Pinging @Jessica P, @Ryan L, @Maya K :eyes:

Jessica P: I can take deploy ownership. I'll be online at 01:45 UTC and will do the traffic shift/cutover. I'll queue the migration via deploy-bot and watch for index build time.

Ryan L: I can own the backfill. Plan: run backfill job `backfill.profiles.bio_text_v2` in 10k row batches with 2s sleep between batches to avoid spikes. Will run on a dedicated worker pool. Command I'll run:```bash
./run_backfill --job backfill.profiles.bio_text_v2 --batch-size 10000 --sleep-ms 2000 --dry-run=false
```

Maya K: I'll do smoke and quick data QA. Canary queries I plan to run right after cutover:```sql
-- sanity: new index used and no NULLs introduced
SELECT count(*) FROM profiles WHERE bio_text_v2 IS NULL;
EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT * FROM profiles WHERE bio_text_v2 LIKE '%engineer%' LIMIT 10;
```
Any expected diff surfaces?

Sam H: Good. Expected diffs are minimal — this is an additive index + copy of existing bio_text (normalized). We'll enable write-through dual-write under feature flag `profiles.v2_write` during the window, then validate canary. Rollback plan is: 1) flip `profiles.v2_write` off (stop writing new v2 values), 2) stop/rollback worker jobs, 3) drop index if needed. Documenting below. Note: index will be built CONCURRENTLY to avoid table locks.

deploy-bot: Scheduled window reserved by Jessica P — users_profiles-migration scheduled 1972468800 (02:00 UTC). Reminder to channel at 15 minutes before window.

SRE Oncall: I'll monitor DB metrics (replication lag, locks, CPU). Please ensure we have slow-query alert threshold set to 2s for the window. If replication lag > 30s or lock time > 60s I'll page. Also recommend temporarily bumping connection pool to handle backfill workers.

Jessica P: I'll prepare a minimal rollback checklist and pin it in this thread. Quick checklist draft:
- stop ingestion to v2: `curl -XPOST https://flagging/profiles.v2_write/off`
- scale down backfill workers: `kubectl scale deploy backfill-workers --replicas=0`
- verify no new rows in v2: `SELECT count(*) FROM profiles WHERE updated_at > now() - interval '5 minutes' AND bio_text_v2 IS NOT NULL;`
- if necessary, run `DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_profiles_bio_text_v2;`

Ryan L: I will do a short dry-run at 01:30 UTC against a snapshot (small subset) and post timings here. If the backfill takes > 4 hours projected we abort and revert to asynchronous backfill approach.

Maya K: I will prepare a small smoke script to run automatically post-cutover and post results to #deploy-notifications. Quick script skeleton:```bash
#!/bin/bash
pg_isready -q && psql -c "SELECT count(*) FROM profiles WHERE bio_text_v2 IS NULL;" && psql -c "EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT * FROM profiles WHERE bio_text_v2 LIKE '%engineer%' LIMIT 10;"
```

Sam H: Thanks all. I'll create a short playbook and attach it to the scheduled window, and add the list of who to call for rollback. Final ops owners: deploy=Jessica P, backfill=Ryan L, smoke=Maya K, infra monitor=SRE Oncall.

Jessica P: Ack. I'll add runbook link here once created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-3312 (will update with exact steps). :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Reminder will be sent at 1972468050 (15m before window).

Sam H: If anything changes ping here. Otherwise we'll reconvene 01:30 for dry-run and 01:45 for final go/no-go.

Ryan L: copying dry-run results to thread after 01:30.

Maya K: I'll post the smoke script and tests at 01:50.

SRE Oncall: I'll enable extra retention for slow query logs just-in-case.

Sam H: Great — closing the loop. If no blockers by 01:40 we'll proceed. :white_check_mark:
